Fields left as 'not stated' in a source finding report are recorded as such here rather than guessed. The field-3 round (2026-08-06) adds matomo-org/matomo as the second L3 row and the first at scale. The adopt-old round (2026-08-07) adds three L3 rows for codebases whose history begins in the 1990s or 2000s: git/git, vim/vim and vdukhovni/postfix.
